findings.title: Service Locator Pattern in RuntimeContext
findings.evidence: Deprecated get() method allows arbitrary key lookup without type safety. Marked as deprecated with DeprecationWarning but still functional.

findings.title: Asyncio.Lock Creation During Kernel Construction
findings.evidence: asyncio.Lock() created in __init__ rather than being injected. This is acceptable for runtime-scoped use but could be made more explicit.

findings.title: UUID Generation During Kernel Construction
findings.evidence: uuid.uuid4() used for entity_id generation. This is acceptable as it is deterministic per construction and does not affect runtime state.
